body:
Thanks! This is notably a very recent regression of https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/83027/. 

Your fix makes sense, and would certainly fix the issue!
However, I don't think this is the appropriate way to fix it. You are right that `CowData` already does the same check, but at this point in the function hierarchy, information about negative indices is lost (since `CowData` doesn't deal with them — `Array` does). So the error message would complain that "index 3 is out of bounds" when you actually passed index `-2`. This may be misleading for users. Therefore, I think an index check in `array.cpp` should stay, redundant as it may be.
Another PR (https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/105334) has already been opened to fix the index check in `array.cpp`, and is bound to be merged soon.

Anyway, it would definitely still be nice to cover this problem with a unit test, as you do. So my proposal is, we wait for https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/105334 to be merged, and then we can merge the unit test of this PR.
